Mohit is a fifth-year PhD student at IIT Delhi, advised by Prof. Sandeep Kumar. 
His research focuses on improving the scalability of graph machine learning. 
At IIT Delhi, his work spans graph coarsening, scalable graph structure learning, and privacy-preserving personalized federated learning for graphs. 
He is also interested in topology-inspired graph ML, with applications in biomedical and neuroscience. 
In addition, he has worked with Adobe Research, where he contributed to LLM-based agentic frameworks.
